collection.title: Ford Fiesta Van 2002 to 2008 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Ford Fiesta Van 2002 to 2008 model which requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
